texts.name: Laurielle
texts.biography: A faithful servant of Elrath for twenty-three centuries past, Laurielle is an Angel who survived the Elder Wars, but not before coming face-to-face with Azkaal, the Prince of Destruction, himself. Manning the battlements of the great flying city Albanora, Laurielle was struck down by the legendary Demon Lord with a searing blow whose memory still haunts her to this very day.

specialty.name: First Aid
specialty.description: Creatures receive a 1% per level bonus to their Health while equipped with a First Aid Tent.
